name: io.github.RedFoxxo/burrow
title: burrow (LeafWiki)
description: Read, search and edit LeafWiki pages with your own account, without overwriting others.

environmentVariables.name: LEAFWIKI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Wiki root, e.g. https://wiki.example.com (https only, except localhost)

environmentVariables.name: LEAFWIKI_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your LeafWiki username or email; empty when the wiki has no sign-in

environmentVariables.name: BURROW_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true offers only the read_ tools
